senses.gloss: नाथ् vt. 1P (but Atm. in the last sense) 1. To ask, to solicit anything, नाथंति के नाम न लोकनाथम् Na.iii.25; 2. to have power, to be master; 3. to harass; 4. to bless, to confer blessings, to wish good to. (See the line त्वामनुनाथते कुचयुगं पत्रावृतं मा कृथाः and Mammata’s remarks on it at, K.Pr.vii.).
नाथ (I) m. 1. A protector, master, leader, lord, R.ii.73, iii.45, K.S.i.58; 2. a husband; 3. a rope passed through the nose of a draft ox.
नाथ-वत् a. 1. dependent; 2. having a leader or protector, नाथवंतस्त्वया लोकास्त्वमनाथा विपत्स्यते Ut.iii.
